description: Search Console API — search analytics, sites, sitemaps, and URL inspection

novel_features.name: Cross-property mover board
novel_features.description: One report covering every verified property: top pages and queries by absolute click delta in the last window, with per-site rollup rows.

novel_features.name: Keyword cannibalization
novel_features.description: Find queries where 2+ pages on the same site rank in the top 20 competing for the same intent; reports impression split and CTR drag.

novel_features.name: Query decay watch
novel_features.description: Queries whose impressions or clicks have steadily declined over a rolling N-week window, ranked by absolute click loss.

novel_features.name: Coverage drift
novel_features.description: Diff successive URL-inspection snapshots: pages whose coverageState, lastCrawlTime, or googleCanonical changed since last sync.

novel_features.name: Opportunity with baseline
novel_features.description: Today's quick-wins (positions 4-20, high-impression / low-CTR) joined to prior daily snapshots so each row carries the date the page entered the opportunity zone.

novel_features.name: New (and lost) queries
novel_features.description: Queries that appeared this week with material impressions and were absent in the prior trailing window; --lost inverts.

novel_features.name: Indexing-issue triage
novel_features.description: Non-INDEXED pages from url_inspections joined against the last 30 days of impressions, ranked by traffic lost.

novel_features.name: Page momentum
novel_features.description: Pages whose 7-day clicks exceed (or fall below) their trailing 28-day daily average by N×, sorted by absolute lift.

novel_features.name: Territorial shift
novel_features.description: For each query, change in country and device mix week-over-week; flags queries whose geo or device split moved more than N points.

novel_features.name: Search-appearance breakdown
novel_features.description: Per-page or per-query breakdown of clicks/impressions by searchAppearance (featured snippet, sitelinks, video, FAQ rich result), with gain/loss flags across windows.

novel_features.name: Sitemap health
novel_features.description: Cross-snapshot diff on per-property sitemap state; flags new errors, new warnings, and indexed-vs-submitted ratio drops.
